title: Combinatorial Sparse PCA Beyond the Spiked Identity Model
summary: Sparse PCA is one of the most well-studied problems in high-dimensional statistics. In this problem, we are given samples from a distribution with covariance $Σ$, whose top eigenvector $v \in R^d$ is $s$-sparse. Existing sparse PCA algorithms can be broadly categorized into (1) combinatorial algorithms (e.g., diagonal or elementwise covariance thresholding) and (2) SDP-based algorithms.
